verdict.rationale: The evidence shows design changes made through AI prompts (natural-language edits, AI-generated design options, a board for sending instructions to AI) and a global color and font control. None of it documents selecting an individual element and editing its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt. The app-wide theme setting is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for per-element visual editing.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip
